newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn offers down, soy steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn offers down, soy steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis offers slipped one cent per bushel from Tuesday, while soybean and winter wheat values were mostly unchanged, dealers said.

Export trade from the U.S. Gulf was light. The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 68,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat early Wednesday from Columbia Grain International for May-June shipment from the Pacific Northwest. The deal included spring, hard red winter and white wheat.
More locks along the upper Mississippi River should reopen late this weekend if high water continues to drop, the U.S. Coast Guard said.
However, high water continued to prevent loading of grain barges on Mississippi north of St Louis.
